title: What If the Caspian Sea Kept Shrinking?

scenes.text: What if the world's largest inland sea slowly drained away? It has started.
The Caspian covers about 371,000 square kilometers, and over 100 million people live around it.
Satellites show it fell about 1.5 meters between 1996 and 2021.
Around 15,000 square kilometers of former sea has already dried out.
By 2100 it could drop roughly 8 to 14 meters, drying the entire northern basin.
The Caspian seal breeds on shrinking northern ice. Evaporation from warming is the main driver.

description:
What if the Caspian Sea kept shrinking?
It has already fallen about 1.5 meters, and a drop of 8 to 14 meters by 2100 would dry the northern basin.
What should we run through next?
